mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 200k signals stronger corporate earnings momentum, which lifts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-200k payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of >10% HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that raises wage inflation and input costs, which reduces profit margins and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE < 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of >2% RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the Industrial Production Index above 1.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher earnings growth, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of >1.5% INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 200k combined with an unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a synchronized labor market tightening, which raises wage inflation and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k AND UNRATE < 5.0% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of PAYEMS > 200k AND UNRATE < 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05).
